overview: A transaction row people can act on. It opens the transaction details (chevron), offers a list of actions (menu) or reveals actions by swiping (swipe).

chevron.title: Chevron
chevron.text: Default. The whole row is one button that opens the details of the transaction. Set `onClick`.

menu.title: Menu
menu.text: `actionType="menu"` shows an overflow button with the options in `menuActions`. On the web the menu opens below the button; on iOS and Android it opens in a bottom sheet. Name the button with `menuLabel` when several rows are on screen.

swipe.title: Swipe
swipe.text: `actionType="swipe"` reveals the same `menuActions` when the row is swiped left. Use it on touch screens and keep at most two actions.

rules: Use this component for any transaction row that responds to a click or tap; use Read Only otherwise.
Use one trailing affordance per row: chevron, menu or swipe.
With two or more actions, use `actionType="menu"`; keep swipe to two actions at most.
Give the overflow button a name that identifies the row (`menuLabel`) when the list has more than one row.
Pass amounts formatted and without a sign; `amount.type` adds the sign and the color.
Place rows inside `List` and set `showDivider={false}` on the last row.
Use `disabled` for unavailable rows; never fade a row with opacity or custom classes.
Don’t rebuild the row with `div` and flex.

api.actionType: Trailing affordance: chevron to open details, overflow menu or swipe to reveal actions.
api.menuActions: Options of the menu and of the swipe. Only with `menu` or `swipe`.
api.menuPosition: Where the menu opens. Only with `actionType="menu"`.
api.menuLabel: Accessible name of the overflow button (`menu` and `swipe`), such as "Actions for Payment to supplier".
